Our client is pioneering the peer-to-peer returns space for the betterment of our planet. The "return-at-will" process is too costly and environmentally damaging. Work on challenging problems, innovate, impacting lots of people's lives for the better while having fun doing it.

What is the length of your engagements?
Most of our long-term full-time engagements last multiple years so you are able to grow your career with the company you are currently working in.

Overview

We're looking for a Fullstack Engineer to join our team. Headquartered in Los Angeles, California, Right Balance applies the latest technology and the best engineering practices to help businesses grow. We’re in the top 50 companies to watch in LA.
Project Details
Our client is a leading software solutions provider in the online advertising market. The platform streamlines the ad sales processes for some of the most prominent publishers on the Web.

We’re committed to continuous innovation by using the latest technologies in the cloud arena. We’re moving to microservices, optimizing the flow of data in the AdTech stack to connect publishers and advertisers in a meaningful way.

You'll be working with a large scale system involving a lot of features, working with terabytes of data in our database. Performance is important for our team, as well as scalability. Constantly challenging the status quo, we're always improving our processes. Your voice will be heard.
You'll make an impact on the team by utilizing your technological experience.

Our stack is .NET on the backend, moving to .NET Core with SQL Server deployed to Azure Cloud. On the frontend, we’re using Vue.js. Our release pipeline is streamlined with CI/CD running on Azure pipelines. For our infrastructure, we believe in managing it as code, currently using Terraform to do so. Some of our services use Azure functions, as well as running in containers on Kubernetes. Having a lot of fun doing it, join us!
What’s in it for you
1. Work with the latest and greatest technologies.
2. Learn from the best people. We constantly challenge the status quo, learn from each other, and invent new ways of building a great product.
3. We actually write automated tests. We take advantage of the latest automation tools like automatic deployments, CI/CD pipelines, and more.
4. Work remotely at the comfort of your home or a shared co-working space.
5. Work on challenging problems, innovate, have fun while doing it.
6. Travel around the world. We offer occasional business trips to work with our clients face to face from their offices.
Required Qualifications
1. 3+ years of professional full-time coding experience.
2. 2+ years .NET experience.
3. 1+ year of frontend experience with Vue.js (preferred), React or Angular.
4. 1+ years of SQL experience.
5. Upper-intermediate to fluent speaking and writing English.
6. Solid understanding of Object Oriented Programming.
7. Azure cloud familiarity.
8. Generics experience.
9. Familiarity with design patterns.
Nice to haves
1. A formal Computer Science or equivalent degree.
2. Professional Azure experience.
3. Experience with XML.
4. Telerik experience.
5. Web services experience, specifically WCF.

Most of our long-term full-time engagements last multiple years.

The Right Balance team is 10 - 15 engineers. The current client team size is 30 engineers expanding to 50 engineers by the end of this year . It’s exciting to be a part of this growth making some meaningful contributions.

Most of our engagements are long-term in nature. That said, if the current project is ramping down, we’ll present you with more long-term opportunities to transition into.

We value autonomy, grind, empathy, mastery, and giving back to the community. We expect you to be autonomous, working directly with the client to build the best product. We value hard work, helping each other, constant learning as well as open-source contributions, and knowledge sharing.
Overview
Headquartered in Los Angeles, California, Right Balance provides top-tier technology talent for innovative companies in the US. We’re in the top 50 companies to watch in LA.
Engagement Details

Our client is an AI-driven competitive intelligence platform built for modern e-commerce brands. They provide real-time visibility into market shifts by tracking hundreds of thousands of brands, retailers, and marketplaces across categories and channels. Their platform delivers insights on pricing, promotions, creative strategy, merchandising, and overall site experience, helping brands make faster and smarter decisions. Backed by experienced ecommerce operators and strong funding, they’re building a category-defining product at the intersection of AI and commerce intelligence.
The Role

Our client is looking for a highly detail-oriented full-stack engineer to join their team with a strong focus on data quality. In this role, you’ll be the go-to expert for ensuring that all 1st party (customer) and 3rd party data they ingest - whether it’s screenshots, emails, Google Ads, or any other data source - is accurate, complete, and reliably collected.
This role will also see you deployed to work directly with data engineers at key customer accounts, helping them strategize on the data they need to solve their business challenges.
Responsibilities

Data Quality Management: Identify gaps or inconsistencies in incoming data. This includes developing robust monitoring processes to detect missing screenshots, incomplete email data, gaps in ad records, and the data quality of our integrations into our customers' infrastructure including Shopify, GA4 and Klaviyo.
Hands-On Problem Solving: Once data issues are identified, you’ll dive into our TypeScript codebase to implement fixes, ensuring that the data pipeline is smooth and robust.

Full-Stack Development: Work as a full-stack engineer, not only troubleshooting data quality issues but also enhancing and maintaining the systems that process our data with a focus on driving data processing cost efficiencies.
Investigative Mindset: Approach problems like a forensics data detective - digging into the “why” behind inconsistencies and leaving no stone unturned until the data is pristine.
AI and Automation: Use AI tools to streamline your workflow, and be comfortable leveraging automation to improve data quality processes.
Proxies and Anti-Bot Expertise: If you have experience dealing with anti-bot mechanisms or using proxies, that’s a huge plus.
Customer Obsessed Mindset: Work closely with our customer success and sales team to prioritize critical data issues impacting both existing and prospective customers.
Define our Metrics. Develop the metrics by which we will track and report on our data quality including progress towards goals. "
